info.title: Tavrik ingestion and approved reports
info.description: Run captures, execution evidence and scoped approved JSON reports. Use your administrator-configured private HTTPS origin. Physical execution and public deployment are not implied.

get.summary: Retrieve approved report revisions for one client project
get.description: 60 requests/minute per credential. Rechecks issuer, expiry, revocation and the recipient's current explicit client-project grant. Returns 25 immutable revisions ordered by publication_id, with next cursor or null. Unknown measurements remain null. Optional report_id requires an exact revision. Metadata only; no raw artifacts or permanent evidence links.

403.description: Expired/revoked credential, issuer or recipient grant

503.description: Report feature disabled or service unavailable

post.summary: Atomically persist a capture or execution evidence and its receipt
post.description: Requires events:write. Tenant/project/robot are resolved from the credential. Retry identical UTF-8 bytes with the same event_id and source_sequence. Sequence namespace spans both types per identity. Receipts survive rotation. run.recorded: max 2 MiB. execution.recorded: max 16 KiB normalized envelope, immutable attempt context plus evidence, run_id equals attempt UUID; exact snapshot must already exist. Validators enforce provenance, units and relationships. Receipt version is the capture workspace version or execution receipt format version 1, not a global ordering clock.

413.description: Body exceeds event-type limit; queue retained

503.description: Disabled or unavailable; retry identical bytes later

get.summary: Reconcile an acknowledgement lost during transport
get.description: Requires receipts:read. Returns metadata only for the credential's own stable identity. Rechecks current authorization, expiry and revocation. Check body_hash against the SHA-256 of the queued bytes before removing them.

404.description: No receipt for this identity/event; submit original queued bytes

clock_skew.description: Observed time more than five minutes ahead of server receipt time; original observation is retained

Invalid.description: Invalid envelope/capture; actionable error string; no event committed

Unauthorized.description: Missing or malformed machine bearer credential

Forbidden.description: Revoked, expired, wrong scope or issuer no longer authorized

Conflict.description: Event ID, source sequence or immutable record conflict; retain and inspect original

Throttled.description: Identity request budget exhausted; retain queue
